options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
- drawable-hdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xxxhdpi

Each of the folders must contain the following file(s):
- morphe_header_custom_dark.png

Required dimensions:
- drawable-hdpi: 121x36 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 160x48 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 240x72 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 320x96 px
